scenario: LUNI.4.3 + LIMP.4.2 — a dimension name brought in via `from <lib> import <dim>` is accepted as the dimension reference on a `unit <sym>: <dim>` declaration. Pin: importing a dim from another library admits it as a valid target for unit-symbol declarations in the importer. The dimension is `span`, not one of `units.core`'s seven, which every file already has and no library may redeclare ([LUNI.4.1.2]). `my_span` is not `span`'s base, so it carries a conversion: only the base omits `=` ([LUNI.4.3]).
rules_ds:
from sub import span

unit my_span: span = x * 2

libraries.sub:
unit dimension span  storage float64  base base_span
unit base_span: span
